name: Barry Windham

tenures.note: The 31 December post carries the fed founder's statement that WWE's release of Windham "opens up an incredible opportunity for Mr. Windham to be reintroduced into LCW storylines"; the 9 January post says he "returned to Legends Championship Wrestling on this week's edition of LCW Showdown" (the 7 January 2009 show).

caption: Returned to the fed on the 7 January 2009 edition of LCW Showdown, after the fed's founder said his release by WWE opened the way to reintroduce him into its storylines.
